blurb: Latham Springs Camp and Retreat Center is a place of inspiration. Located on 500 beautiful acres along the Brazos River in the heart of Texas, Latham Springs offers camp and retreat facilities for groups of up to 850. Whether you are planning a church retreat, a group conference, or a full-service camp experience, Latham Springs has an unmatched open country setting, flexible accommodations, and seasoned staff.
